details.description: Gemini 3 Flash Preview is Google DeepMind's Flash-tier model in the Gemini 3 series, positioned by Google for agentic applications and visual coding tasks. It is natively multimodal, accepting text, image, video, audio and PDF input over up to a 1,048,576-token context window with up to 65,536 output tokens, and supports configurable thinking levels (minimal, low, medium and high) to trade reasoning depth against latency, per its Gemini API model page. Its knowledge cutoff is January 2025. It remains a preview release, and Google DeepMind's current Gemini model overview page no longer lists it by name, having moved on to later Gemini 3.x point releases such as 3.1, 3.5 and 3.8.
advantages: Supports configurable thinking levels (minimal, low, medium, high), defaulting to high (dynamic) reasoning depth, with minimal available to minimize latency for chat or high-throughput use, per Google's Gemini 3 developer guide.
Supports built-in computer use, function calling, code execution, file search, Google Search and Maps grounding, URL context retrieval, and structured outputs, per its Gemini API model page.
Can zoom, crop and annotate images step by step through code execution with images, for detailed visual analysis, per Google's Gemini 3 documentation.
disadvantages: Remains a preview release; Google DeepMind's current Gemini model overview page no longer lists it by name, having moved on to later Gemini 3.x point releases.
Knowledge cutoff of January 2025, per Google's Gemini 3 documentation.
Does not support audio generation, image generation, or the Live API, per its Gemini API model page.
use_cases: Agentic applications that call tools across multi-step tasks
Visual coding and step-by-step image analysis (zoom, crop, annotate)
General multimodal understanding of text, image, video, audio and PDF input
Low-latency, high-throughput chat with adjustable reasoning depth

notes: No benchmark scores specific to gemini-3-flash-preview were found on the pages I opened; Gemini 3.8 Flash's benchmark table on deepmind.google/models/gemini/flash/ is for a later, different GA model and was not used here, so evaluations is left empty. Google DeepMind's current Gemini model overview page (deepmind.google/models/gemini/) lists only later 3.x point releases (3.8 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.1 Pro, 3.1 Deep Think), not this preview model by name. Verify pass: Google's deprecations page (checked 2026-09-25) lists gemini-3-flash-preview with 'No shutdown date announced' and recommends gemini-3.6-flash as its replacement. Also corrected an error: the Gemini 3 developer guide's thinking-level table marks 'high' as the default (Default, Dynamic) for Gemini 3 Flash -- minimal is default only for the separate Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite model -- so the advantages claim that minimal is this model's default was fixed.
